risk_assessment.chain_of_thought_reasoning:
1. METEOROLOGICAL ANALYSIS: Active cloudburst/extreme rainfall event (78.5 mm/h, 24h cumulative 210.0 mm) with sharp barometric depression (-6.2 hPa) and squall gusts (92.0 km/h).
2. HYDRAULIC & RIVERINE STAGE: River Kamrup Metropolitan River Drainage Basin has BREACHED the official Danger Level (55.50 m) at 59.860 m (buffer: +4.360 m). Rate of rise is surging at +0.000 m/h.
3. TOPOGRAPHIC RUNOFF BEHAVIOR: Catchment terrain has low permeability (Loam, runoff coefficient 0.55, TWI 16.8), accelerating overland surge directly into drainage networks (choke ratio: 100%).
4. SPACEBORNE OBSERVATION: Clear sky condition (20% cloud); optical NDWI (0.380) and SAR radar (-18.2 dB) corroborate surface water extent.
5. CROSS-DOMAIN SYNTHESIS: Multi-agent consensus weighted score evaluates to 0.950 with 90.2% sensor certainty. Conclusion: CRITICAL FLOOD DISASTER CONFIRMED along River Kamrup Metropolitan River Drainage Basin in Kamrup Metropolitan district.

decision_and_early_warning.public_broadcast_sms: [URGENT ROUTE DIVERSION] [CRITICAL EVACUATION DIVERSION]: Shelter A (Kamrup Metropolitan North Municipal High School & Relief Camp) has been COMPROMISED by expanding floodwaters! DO NOT PROCEED NORTH-EAST. All evacuees must IMMEDIATELY DIVERT WESTWARD along the Elevated Ridge Parkway to SHELTER B (Kamrup Metropolitan Central Elevated Sports Stadium & Highland Ridge), located at +32.0m higher ground. [RED FLOOD DELUGE ALERT] River Kamrup Metropolitan River Drainage Basin has BREACHED DANGER LEVELS in Kamrup Metropolitan. Immediate mandatory evacuation ordered for: Kamrup Metropolitan River Drainage Basin Low-lying Embankments, Kamrup Metropolitan Central Sluice Gate Basin, Kamrup Metropolitan Main Drainage Outfall Sector. Move to designated higher ground shelters immediately! Call 112 / 1070 for rescue.

recommended_tactical_actions.action: Deploy civil defense wardens to seal off inundated Shelter A access road. Direct all citizen convoys along Western Ridge Parkway to Shelter B (Kamrup Metropolitan Central Elevated Sports Stadium & Highland Ridge).
Deploy 4 NDRF battalions & SDRF motorized rescue boats to Kamrup Metropolitan River Drainage Basin Low-lying Embankments, Kamrup Metropolitan Central Sluice Gate Basin.
Full closure of Kamrup Metropolitan River Drainage Basin outfall sluice gates to prevent backflow into Kamrup Metropolitan municipal storm channels.
Activate all auxiliary heavy dewatering diesel pumps (5000 gpm); shut down inundated electrical transformers.
Enforce traffic diversions across arterial bridges and secure elevated evacuation corridors to district relief shelters.
Establish mobile medical clinics, potable water tankers, and dry ration distribution in designated cyclone/flood shelters.
